# Expedia

> Expedia is a comprehensive travel platform offering flight bookings, hotel accommodations, activities, and vacation rentals across global destinations.

Expedia provides travelers with tools to discover, plan, and book complete vacation experiences including lodging, attractions, and activities. The platform features One Key membership benefits, competitive pricing, and extensive destination coverage from Hawaii to Las Vegas to New York.

## Key Topics

- Hotel Search
- Flight Bookings
- Activities & Attractions
- Vacation Rentals
- One Key Membership
- Things to Do
- Destination Discovery
- Budget Accommodation
- Travel Deals
- Local Search
- Event Tickets
- Motel Rentals
- Travel Guide
- Accommodation Booking
- Membership Pricing

- [Things To Do Near Me - Find Attractions and Activities | Expedia](https://www.expedia.com/Activities?siteid=1&langid=1033&clickref=1100lyoMGkBk&affcid=US.DIRECT.PHG.1100l246471.1100l68075&ref_id=1100lyoMGkBk&my_ad=AFF.US.DIRECT.PHG.1100l246471.1100l68075&afflid=1100lyoMGkBk): Browse attractions, activities and things to do across destinations like Hawaii and Hollywood with Expedia.

## Accommodations

- [Motels: Find the best and cheapest Motels rentals | Expedia.com](https://www.expedia.com/aa/Motels): Search and book budget motel accommodations worldwide with One Key membership pricing and traveler reviews.
